Intelligent Message Retry & Automated Failure Notification using SAP CPI

A multi-iFlow asynchronous retry and failure notification architecture (iflow 1 jms retry, iflow 2 jms retry, iflow 3 jms retry) that decouples message ingestion via an encrypted JMS queue, classifies exceptions using Groovy, executes exponential-backoff retries, and sends automated email alerts after 3 failed retry attempts.

End-to-End JMS Retry & Failure Notification Pipeline Queue: JMS & DLQ • Retry Interval: 1m to 60m (Exponential Backoff)

Automated Email Alert

Initial Attempt vs. Retry Count

The initial delivery runs with SAPJMSRetries = 0. When a transient error occurs and SAPJMSRetries < '3', the message hits an Error End Event and rolls back to the JMS queue for up to 3 retry attempts (Retries 1, 2, and 3).

Exception Classification in Groovy

Inside the Exception Subprocess, Evaluate_Exception inspects up to 10 cause levels of CamelExceptionCaught. Permanent errors (HTTP 400/401/403/404 or XML/JSON parse errors) bypass retries immediately, while 5xx timeouts are marked retryable.

Automated Email Notification

Once ${property.SAPJMSRetries} >= '3' (on the 4th total delivery attempt after 3 failed retries), the router formats a diagnostic report with the preserved payload and sends an automated email via the Mail Adapter (smtp.gmail.com:587).

Verified Script from Package: iflow 2 jms retry.iflw → script1.groovy (Evaluate_Exception) 
import com.sap.gateway.ip.core.customdev.util.Message

def Message processData(Message message) {
    def ex = message.getProperty("CamelExceptionCaught")
    String details = ""
    def current = ex
    int depth = 0

    while (current != null && depth < 10) {
        details += current.getClass().getName() + ": "
        details += (current.getMessage() ?: "") + " | "
        current = current.getCause()
        depth++
    }

    String lower = details.toLowerCase()
    def matcher = (details =~ /(?<!\d)(400|401|403|404|408|429|500|502|503|504)(?!\d)/)
    String errorCode = matcher.find() ? matcher.group(1) : "UNKNOWN"

    boolean permanent = false
    if (errorCode in ["400", "401", "403", "404"]) {
        permanent = true
    } else if (
        lower.contains("saxparseexception") ||
        lower.contains("mappingexception") ||
        lower.contains("jsonparseexception") ||
        lower.contains("invalid xml")
    ) {
        permanent = true
    }

    message.setProperty("ErrorCode", errorCode)
    message.setProperty("ErrorDetails", details)
    message.setProperty("ErrorType", permanent ? "PERMANENT" : "RETRYABLE")
    message.setProperty("RetryExceptionValid", permanent ? "false" : "true")

    return message
}
